Tamil Nadu CM's UK Trip Sparks Political Row Over Investment Claims

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay's visit to London to attract investment has triggered a political row in the state. The AIADMK questioned the necessity of the overseas trip, particularly at taxpayer expense. They also raised questions about a reported Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with a Noida-based firm, suggesting it was unnecessary to travel abroad for such a deal. Opposition parties are seeking answers regarding the expenses incurred during the Chief Minister's visit.
